statusNote: Pattern names, regions and area shares were read from the publication pages on 2026-11-08 through an automated page summary, not from the full text. They are real, citable papers, but a person must confirm each row against the original paper (and an agronomist should confirm the crop mapping) before anyone says 'BRRI-documented' in public. 'Documented' here means: reported in a BRRI/BARI field survey or trial. It does not mean recommended for a given farm, and it says nothing about yield or profit. EXTENDED 2026-11-13: further patterns for Rangpur, the coastal south-west, Mymensingh, Cumilla, Kushtia and Sylhet were added from BanglaJOL / ICAR journal abstract pages only (no full text read). Same rule applies: confirm each against the paper before saying 'documented' in public.
mapping: Each pattern is stored as the set of crops it contains. A rotation is 'documented' if its crops are a subset of one pattern (leaving a season fallow is always possible). Crops in a paper that Field Shift has no crop row for (blackgram, garden pea, B. Aman, Sesbania, felon, vegetables in general) are left out of that pattern's crop set. Field Shift allows at most 3 crops a year, so the 4-crop pattern is used through its 3-crop subsets.
